title: Challenge specification frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter at the top of every specs/challenges/<id>/spec.md. Validated by scripts/validate_specs.py.

id.description: Directory name. Must match the folder it lives in.

depends_on.description: Challenge ids that should be completed first. Must form a DAG.

endpoints.description: API operations this challenge exercises. Each must exist in specs/openapi.json.

figma_node.description: node-id in the Figma file, e.g. '13-5855'. Null for challenges with no design.

mockups.description: Repo-relative paths to reference images. Each must exist on disk.

testids.description: data-testid values the UI must expose. This is the contract that makes a front-end verifiable without dictating a framework. Required (non-empty) for web and mobile tracks.

verify.description: Harness module that checks this challenge. Null when verification is manual.

verifiable.description: False when the harness cannot check this automatically (documented honestly rather than implied).
